main:2.text: Godrick the Grafted (接ぎ木のゴドリック, Tsugiki no Godorikku) is a Boss in Elden Ring. He is a Demigod and a Shardbearer encountered in Stormveil Castle. Godrick is a descendant of the Golden Lineage, the bloodline that began with Queen Marika the Eternal and her first consort Godfrey. Only a distant relation of Marika's line, his divine blood was sorely diluted, and he was viewed as the runt of the litter.

main:3.page: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
main:3.text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon (満月の女王、レナラ, Mangetsu no Joō, Renara) is a character in Elden Ring. She is a Shardbearer Boss encountered in the Academy of Raya Lucaria. While this encounter is not required to advance the story, Rennala must be defeated to unlock the ability to respec, Moonlight Altar, and "Age of the Stars" ending.

main:4.text: Starscourge Radahn (星砕きのラダーン, Hoshikudaki no Radān), also known as General Radahn, the Red Lion General, and later as Promised Consort Radahn and Radahn, Consort of Miquella, is an optional Demigod boss in Elden Ring and a mandatory God boss in Elden Ring:;Shadow of the Erdtree. General Radahn was feared as the strongest Demigod during the Shattering.

main:5.text: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is a boss in Elden Ring. He is a Demigod and a Shardbearer who is encountered in Volcano Manor. Rykard was born the son of Radagon, a champion of the Erdtree, and Queen Rennala, head of both the Carian Royal Family and the Academy of Raya Lucaria. He had two siblings, Radahn and Ranni. At some point, the first Elden Lord, Godfrey, was robbed of grace and hounded from the Lands Between.

main:6.text: Morgott, the Omen King, is a remembrance boss in Elden Ring. He is a Demigod and a Shardbearer who is encountered in Leyndell, Royal Capital. He is not an optional boss and must be defeated to unlock Mountaintops of the Giants and progress the story. Morgott was a direct offspring of Lord Godfrey and Queen Marika, and the rightful heir to their Golden Lineage.

main:7.text: The Fire Giant (火の巨人, Hi no Kyojin) is a boss in Elden Ring. He is encountered at Flame Peak on the Mountaintops of the Giants. This encounter is not optional as it must be completed to unlock Crumbling Farum Azula and advance the main storyline. The Fire Giant is a gargantuan, red-haired humanoid with a slumbering, bearded face on its front torso.

main:9.text: Maliketh, the Black Blade is a boss in Elden Ring, encountered in Crumbling Farum Azula. This is not an optional boss as Maliketh must be defeated to unlock Leyndell, Ashen Capital and reach the endgame of Elden Ring. Maliketh is the loyal Shadowbound Beast and half-brother of Queen Marika the Eternal, an Empyrean of Numen descent, who would become the vessel of the Elden Ring.

main:10.text: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing (百智卿、ギデオン オーフニール, Hyakuchikyō, Gideon Ōfunīru) is an NPC and boss in Elden Ring. Gideon Ofnir is the Tarnished leader of Roundtable Hold and the adoptive father of Nepheli Loux. Called to the Lands Between by the guidance of Grace, Gideon wishes to become Elden Lord.

main:11.text: Hoarah Loux, Warrior, also known as Godfrey, First Elden Lord and the Lord of the Battlefield, is a mandatory boss in Elden Ring. Godfrey is a former consort of Queen Marika the Eternal and the first Elden Lord of the Golden Order. Although his actions directly shaped much of the history of the Lands Between, Queen Marika stole his grace and banished him to the badlands.

main:12.text: Radagon of the Golden Order is a boss in Elden Ring. He is encountered inside the Erdtree in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, and is the first half of the final boss fight, with the Elden Beast as the second half. Radagon first rose to prominence during the Liurnian Wars, when he joined the heroes' ranks.

main:13.text: The Elden Beast is the final Boss of Elden Ring, encountered on the Stone Platform inside the Erdtree at Leyndell, Ashen Capital, fought directly after Radagon of the Golden Order. A long-necked, aquatic creature, the Elden Beast is a living constellation of shimmering Amber Starlight suspended in a translucent silhouette.

boss:1.text: Malenia, Blade of Miquella, later known as Malenia, Goddess of Rot, is an optional remembrance Boss in Elden Ring. She is a Demigod Shardbearer who is encountered in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. A Demigod daughter of Queen Marika the Eternal and her second Elden Lord, King Consort Radagon, Malenia was born during the age of the Elden Ring.

boss:2.text: Mohg, Lord of Blood and Mohg, the Omen are Bosses in Elden Ring. Luminary Mohg is a Demigod and a Shardbearer who is encountered in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and at the Mohgwyn Palace. Mohg, also known as the Lord of Blood, was born of the Golden Lineage—the offspring of Queen Marika and Godfrey, First Elden Lord—and was the twin brother of Morgott.

boss:3.text: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void is an optional Boss in Elden Ring. Far beyond the Lands Between, within the Greater Will's lightless abyss, the many-colored debris of ancient stars coalesced into a malformed creature. A falling star of ill omen, Astel arrived long ago. It assailed an Eternal City with a barrage of meteors, sealing it deep underground, away from the true night sky.

boss:4.text: Dragonlord Placidusax is a Remembrance Boss in Elden Ring, encountered in Crumbling Farum Azula. Dragonlord Placidusax is a quadrupedal dragon with two wizened heads and a grievously wounded gravel stone body. The scales protecting his head and back are drained of color, while those on his underbelly are vibrant gold.

boss:6.text: Loretta is the boss of two locations: Caria Manor and Miquella's Haligtree. Her oath-sworn spectral form—Royal Knight Loretta—is found at the former, while her corporeal body defends the latter. Loretta is mechanically similar to the Tree Sentinels and Draconic Tree Sentinels and cannot be separated from her steed. Loretta was once a royal Carian knight, and served as a personal guard for Carian royalty.

boss:8.text: The Regal Ancestor Spirit is an optional Remembrance boss in Elden Ring. It is encountered at the northern Hallowhorn Grounds along the Siofra River after lighting six bonfires. Deer-like spirits found in Siofra River. They exist beyond the purview of the Erdtree, and follow the principle that life sprouts from death as it does from birth.

main:8.text: The Godskin Duo share one health bar of around 24000 HP (NG), but also still have their own HP. If one is killed, it will either respawn automatically after ~15 seconds or the other Godskin will reanimate them. They will also still enter phase 2 if dropping close to 50% in individual HP.

boss:5.text: Fortissax is an Ancient Dragon who was once known as the "mightiest boulderstone", known for its use of twin red lightning stakes, and the sibling of Ancient Dragon Lansseax. During the Age of the Erdtree, the Ancient Dragons warred against the forces of Leyndell, after an assault on the royal capital by the great Ancient Dragon Gransax. Fortissax was challenged by Godwyn the Golden, who fought to the last.

boss:7.text: Commander Niall, a veteran general of Castle Sol, offered his prosthesis in exchange for the lives of imprisoned knights, forming an army of no nation. A lone survivor, Niall commands the spirits of deceased knights to defend his master, who has long passed.

collectible:1.text: Blessing of the Erdtree, worshiped in the churches of all lands; this is but a faint vestige. Increases the potency of a Sacred Flask's restorative effects. (Can be used after resting at a site of grace.) During the age of the Erdtree, these tears were used to spread the faith, for theirs was once a certain blessing.
